name: select-field
title: SelectField
description: TanStack Form select field composed with Keystone Select behavior and Mason styling hooks.

meta.customization: Use mason-select-field classes and data-part values while TanStack Form owns field state and Keystone owns listbox behavior.

parity.tanstackForm: First-class comparison is TanStack Form: the component binds field state to Keystone Select behavior with generated Mason source. Gaps: async validation examples, field array coordination, schema adapters, submission lifecycle helpers, and richer error presentation remain follow-up work.
parity.baseUi: Behavior parity for the underlying select should track Base UI Select/Listbox depth: collection registration, keyboard navigation, typeahead, positioning, hidden form value, and data attributes. Gaps: grouped/multi select, scroll arrows, virtualized collections, and modal/non-modal popup policy remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Solid reference is Kobalte Select plus form-control composition. Gaps: hidden select parity, reset listener depth, section APIs, and complete popper/focus management coverage remain follow-up work.
